name: Ireland
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: Ogham
inventions.description: Ogham is an Early Medieval alphabet used primarily to write the early Irish language, and later the Old Irish language.

inventions.name: Magnesium hydroxide
inventions.description: Magnesium hydroxide is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula Mg(OH)2.

inventions.name: Hypodermic needle
inventions.description: A hypodermic needle is a very thin, hollow tube with one sharp tip.

inventions.name: Anemometer
inventions.description: In meteorology, an anemometer is a device that measures wind speed and direction.

inventions.name: Stethoscope
inventions.description: The stethoscope is a medical device for auscultation, or listening to internal sounds of an animal or human body.

inventions.name: Transatlantic telegraph cable
inventions.description: Transatlantic telegraph cables are undersea cables running under the Atlantic Ocean which were used for telegraph communications.

inventions.name: Respirator
inventions.description: A respirator is type of mask designed to protect the wearer from inhaling hazardous atmospheres including lead fumes, vapors, gases and particulate matter such as dusts and airborne pathogens such as viruses.

inventions.name: Brennan torpedo
inventions.description: The Brennan torpedo was a torpedo patented by Irish-born Australian inventor Louis Brennan in 1877.

inventions.name: Conveyor belt
inventions.description: A conveyor belt is the carrying medium of a belt conveyor system.

inventions.name: Three-point hitch
inventions.description: The three-point hitch is a widely used type of hitch for attaching plows and other implements to an agricultural or industrial tractor.

inventions.name: Drumm Battery Train
inventions.description: The Drumm Battery Train was an Irish battery electric multiple unit developed in the 1930s which ran successfully in service on the Dublin to Bray route.

inventions.name: Ejection seat
inventions.description: In aircraft, an ejection seat or ejector seat is a system designed to rescue the pilot or other crew of an aircraft in an emergency.
